item.title: Max Radio .CA, Vancouver’s Variety!
item.description: Click the play button to open a universal Max Radio player in its own window. The new player works on all platforms with full album art and ID tags! For desktop and tablet browsers, a new generation player available as of May 25th 2025! A new generation mini-player also available now! Max Radio is Vancouver's Variety Internet Radio Station!
